<skill_content name="github-api-search">
# Skill: github-api-search

# github-api-search — GitHub REST API через curl

## Аутентификация
- Без токена: 60 запросов/час
- С токеном: 5000/час

```bash
# Как прочитать токен (из auth.json или переменной окружения)
TOKEN=$(jq -r '.github.key // ""' ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json 2>/dev/null || echo "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}")
[ -n "$TOKEN" ] && AUTH="-H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'" || AUTH=""
```

## Эндпоинты

| Действие | URL | Описание |
|----------|-----|----------|
| Поиск репозиториев | `GET /search/repositories?q=...` | Поиск по имени, описанию, readme |
| Инфо о репозитории | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}` | Звёзды, лицензия, темы, язык |
| README | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/readme` | README в base64 → декодировать |
| Содержимое файла | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}` | Любой файл из репозитория |
| Поиск кода | `GET /search/code?q=...` | Поиск в коде репозиториев |
| Релизы | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases` | Список релизов с тегами |
| Issues | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues` | Открытые/закрытые issues |

## Примеры

### Поиск репозиториев
```bash
curl -s "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=telegram+mcp+server&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=10" | jq '[.items[] | {name: .full_name, stars: .stargazers_count, desc: .description}]'
```

### Информация о репозитории
```bash
curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/mcp-telegram/mcp-telegram" | jq '{name: .full_name, stars: .stargazers_count, license: .license.spdx_id, topics: .topics}'
```

### README (декодировать base64)
```bash
curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/mcp-telegram/mcp-telegram/readme" | jq -r '.content' | base64 -d
```

### Содержимое файла
```bash
curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/mcp-telegram/mcp-telegram/contents/package.json" | jq -r '.content' | base64 -d
```

### Поиск кода
```bash
curl -s "https://api.github.com/search/code?q=mcp+telegram+in:name&per_page=10" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" | jq '[.items[] | {name: .name, repo: .repository.full_name, path: .path}]'
```

### Релизы
```bash
curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/mcp-telegram/mcp-telegram/releases?per_page=10" | jq '[.[] | {tag: .tag_name, name: .name, prerelease: .prerelease, created: .created_at}]'
```

## Параметры запросов
- `?q=` — поисковый запрос
- `&sort=stars|updated|forks`
- `&order=desc|asc`
- `&per_page=N` (max 100)
- `&page=N`
- Квалификаторы: `in:name`, `in:description`, `in:readme`, `language:python`, `stars:>100`, `topic:mcp`

## Обработка ошибок
- **403** — rate limit (без токена 60/ч; с токеном 5000/ч)
- **404** — репозиторий/файл не найден
- **422** — неверный запрос
- **401** — плохой токен

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://api.github.com/repos/mcp-telegram/mcp-telegram"
```

1: # better-escape.nvim
2: 
3: ![better-escape](https://github.com/max397574/better-escape.nvim/assets/81827001/8863a620-b075-4417-92d0-7eb2d2646186)
4: 
5: A lot of people have mappings like `jk` or `jj` to escape insert mode. The
6: problem with this mappings is that whenever you type a `j`, neovim wait about
7: 100-500ms (depending on your timeoutlen) to see, if you type a `j` or a `k`
8: because these are mapped. Only after that time the `j` will be inserted. Then
9: you always get a delay when typing a `j`.
10: 
11: An example where this has a big impact is e.g. telescope. Because the characters
12: which are mapped aren't really inserted at first the whole filtering isn't

# better-escape.nvim

![better-escape](https://github.com/max397574/better-escape.nvim/assets/81827001/8863a620-b075-4417-92d0-7eb2d2646186)

A lot of people have mappings like `jk` or `jj` to escape insert mode. The
problem with this mappings is that whenever you type a `j`, neovim wait about
100-500ms (depending on your timeoutlen) to see, if you type a `j` or a `k`
because these are mapped. Only after that time the `j` will be inserted. Then
you always get a delay when typing a `j`.

An example where this has a big impact is e.g. telescope. Because the characters
which are mapped aren't really inserted at first the whole filtering isn't
instant.

[](#installation-directory)

The install script respects the following priority order for the installation path:

1.  `$OPENCODE_INSTALL_DIR` - Custom installation directory
2.  `$XDG_BIN_DIR` - XDG Base Directory Specification compliant path

### Agents

[](#agents)

OpenCode includes two built-in agents you can switch between with the `Tab` key.

-   **build** - Default, full-access agent for development work
-   **plan** - Read-only agent for analysis and code exploration
    -   Denies file edits by default
    -   Asks permission before running bash commands
    -   Ideal for exploring unfamiliar codebases or planning changes

Also included is a **general** subagent for complex searches and multistep tasks. This is used internally and can be invoked using `@general` in messages.

57: ## Default configuration
58: 
59: To disable all default mappings set the `default_mappings` option to false.   
60: To disable specific mappings set their key to `false` in the configuration. There's an example in the Customization section.
61: 
62: ```lua
63: -- lua, default settings
64: require("better_escape").setup {
65:     timeout = vim.o.timeoutlen, -- after `timeout` passes, you can press the escape key and the plugin will ignore it
66:     default_mappings = true, -- setting this to false removes all the default mappings
67:     mappings = {
68:         -- i for insert
69:         i = {
70:             j = {
71:                 -- These can all also be functions
72:                 k = "<Esc>",
73:                 j = "<Esc>",
74:             },
75:         },
76:         c = {
77:             j = {
78:                 k = "<C-c>",
79:                 j = "<C-c>",
80:             },
81:         },
82:         t = {
83:             j = {
84:                 k = "<C-\\><C-n>",
85:             },
86:         },
87:         v = {
88:             j = {
89:                 k = "<Esc>",
90:             },
91:         },
92:         s = {
93:             j = {
94:                 k = "<Esc>",
95:             },
96:         },
97:     },
98: }
99: ```
100: ## ⚙️Customization
101: 
102: Call the setup function with your options as arguments:
103: ```lua
104: require("better_escape").setup {
105:     timeout = vim.o.timeoutlen, -- after `timeout` passes, you can press the escape key and the plugin will ignore it
106:     default_mappings = true, -- setting this to false removes all the default mappings
107:     mappings = {
108:         -- mode = {
109:         --     firstkey = {
110:         --        secondkey = "Escape key", -- make a key press "Escape key"
111:         --        secondkey = false, -- disable a key
112:         --     },
113:         -- }
114:     }
115: }
116: ```
117: 
118: Here how you can configure Insert-mode:
119: ```lua
120: mappings = {
121:     -- i for insert, other modes are the first letter too
122:     i = {
123:         -- map kj to exit insert mode
124:         k = {
125:             j = "<Esc>",
126:         },
127:         -- map jk and jj  to exit insert mode
128:         j = {
129:             k = "<Esc>",
130:             j = "<Esc>",
131:         },
132:         -- disable jj
133:         j = {
134:             j = false,
135:         },
136:     }
137: }
138: ```
139: 
140: You can also use a function instead of keys. So you could for example map
141: `<space><tab>` to jump with luasnip like this:
142: 
143: ```lua
144: i = {
145:     [" "] = {
146:         ["<tab>"] = function()
147:             -- Defer execution to avoid side-effects
148:             vim.defer_fn(function()
149:                 -- set undo point
150:                 vim.o.ul = vim.o.ul
151:                 require("luasnip").expand_or_jump()
152:             end, 1)
153:         end
154:     }
155: }
156: ```
157: 
158: ## API

160: `require("better_escape").waiting` is a boolean indicating that it's waiting for
161: a mapped sequence to complete.
162: 
163: ```lua
164: function escape_status()
165:   local ok, m = pcall(require, 'better_escape')
166:   return ok and m.waiting and '✺' or ""
167: end
